sources.label: NAUR LesBin P1 (Role + Fixed Tether Utopia, Conga Fall of Faith)

steps.title: Cyclonic Break clock spots
steps.cue: Cyclonic Break cast, boss wreathed in fire or lightning
steps.rule: Take your clock spot around the boss: MT close in front (north), OT east, H1 west, H2 south, M1 south-west, M2 south-east, R1 north-west, R2 north-east. Every cone aims at its player, so keep apart.

steps.title: Dodge the repeat (spread or pairs)
steps.cue: First Cyclonic Break cones go off
steps.rule: The cones fire again where they first hit. Lightning: slide one cone-width clockwise and spread. Fire: meet your partner 8m out between your spots for Sinsmoke pairs: MT with R1, OT with R2, H2 with M2, H1 with M1.

steps.title: Back to your clock spot
steps.rule: Return to your original spot: the next set of cones turns one cone-width clockwise, onto the gap you just used.

steps.title: Slide clockwise again
steps.cue: Turned Cyclonic Break cones go off
steps.rule: Once the turned cones go off, slide one cone-width clockwise again; the last set turns one more width past you.

steps.title: Check your image
steps.cue: Utopian Sky cast, Powder Mark Trail on the main tank
steps.rule: Go out to the wall in your direction and see whether that image raises its gunblade: MT north, R1 north-west, H1 west, M1 south-west, H2 south, M2 south-east, R2 east.

OffTank.rule: Check the north-east image from 14m in, so you are the closest player to the MT and take the second Powder Mark hit.

steps.title: Line up on the safe axis
steps.rule: The safe axis is the one with no raised gunblade on either end. Light party 1 (MT, H1, M1, R1) takes its west end (north if the axis is north-south), light party 2 (OT, H2, M2, R2) the other end. Sinbound Fire: stack with your light party. Sinbound Thunder: spread along the end, tank deepest, healer closest to the centre, melee clockwise and ranged counter-clockwise of the tank.
